title: Standing method grants for read-only cognition
problem: A signed read-only mission whose question fits a registered, verified, read-only method blocks on a CAPABILITY_ATTACH per method, and the only remedy (a global attach) outlives the mission and the founder's review.
baseline: Canonical 9b931994: cognition methods attach only by founder CAPABILITY_ATTACH; auto_attach never attaches a cognition method.

alternatives.name: Let auto_attach attach cognition methods
alternatives.description: Extend the read-only auto_attach to cognition.
disadvantages: The attach is global and permanent; revoking the mission does not stop it
alternatives.revival_evidence: Attachment becomes mission-scoped in the registry

alternatives.name: Grant inside each MISSION spec
alternatives.description: A method list in every signed mission.
disadvantages: One review per mission, not per method set
alternatives.revival_evidence: Founders prefer per-mission review in use

do_nothing_option.expected_outcome: One founder action per withheld method, and methods left attached body-wide.
disadvantages: The Mind waits on the founder for work it may lawfully do

roles.position: Item 2 of the 2026-11-22 directive, on the existing signed process.
material_concerns: Consequential actions keep their own authority

roles.position: Two founder-only command kinds, one module and a per-call registry view; the registry, the authority office and the light cone are unchanged.
material_concerns: Uses are counted from the method ids a receipt names

roles.position: Seven mutants are all caught; the rehearsal's naive grant arm lost (6/10) and is kept.
greg grant issue, revoke, list and suggest; revocation takes effect on the next call.
material_concerns: A composition that names no method is not counted

roles.position: Read-only methods and read-only missions only; nothing is spent, sent or published.
material_concerns: A grant must never cover an acting capability

evidence.claim: Inside the grant the mission closes with no ask and nothing attached
A suggested grant cuts founder actions and waiting
evidence.finding: 1 vs 5 actions; 1 vs 11 unanswered ticks; 10/10 both

counterevidence.claim: A grant from the drawn families underperforms

pass_1.intended_outcome: One founder signature covers the reviewed read-only methods a class of questions needs, for a bounded window, with no permanent attach.

advantages.statement: Founder actions scale with reviews, not with questions
advantages.amplified_value: Standing missions keep moving while the founder is away

disadvantages.statement: The founder may grant the wrong set
disadvantages.redesigned_response: greg grant suggest previews the compiler's picks

disadvantages.statement: A grant could be read as consequence authority
disadvantages.redesigned_response: Only read-only cognition ids and read-only missions; the Gate is unchanged

comparisons.do_nothing: the founder waits on every method
comparisons.reversible_experiment: grants expire within 30 days and are revocable

pass_2.attack_summary: Attacked revocation, expiry, use limits, detaches and ceilings as deployed.

new_weaknesses.statement: A reissued grant id could widen a grant
A view could write the registry

pass_1_disadvantage_dispositions.review_trigger: A grant that misses its questions in use

pass_2.final_design: METHOD_GRANT and METHOD_GRANT_REVOKE, a per-call GrantView, method_grant.used per receipt, and greg grant issue, revoke, list and suggest.

residual_risks.risk: Composition-stage questions still end in a generic ask
residual_risks.mitigation: Reported; #340's resolution path is the candidate

migration_plan: Additive. Bodies without grants behave as before. Merging is the founder's decision.

steps: git revert the branch; existing grant records stay as history and lift nothing

kill_criteria: A grant lifts a non-read-only method
A revoked, expired or used-up grant still lifts a method
review_trigger: Founder review of the draft PR
